`--num_components`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of principal components to compute. Defaults to 50, or 1 - minimum dimension size of selected representation.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Example]{.arg-key} `25`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--chunked`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
If True, perform an incremental PCA on segments of a predefined size. Setting this flag automatically implies zero centering.
Must be specified together with --chunk_size.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--chunk_size`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of observations to include in each chunk. Required if chunked=True was passed.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `2`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--seed`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Used to set the initial states for the optimization.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/dimred/pca/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/dimred/pca);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/dimred/pca/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
